defaultReminderHourLocal.description: Local hour (0-23 in firm timezone) after which hourly register reminder sweeps emit due and review reminders.

defaultDueDaysBefore.description: Default reminder lead/overdue offsets in days relative to dueAt for registers when not overridden per type.

defaultReviewDaysBefore.description: Default reminder lead offsets in days relative to reviewAt for periodic register review schedules.

customTypes.description: Tenant-defined custom firm registers configured without modifying core platform code.

typeOverrides.description: Per-register-type overrides keyed by register key (e.g. sign_off, undertaking, complaint, breach, or custom register key).

label.description: Display label shown on forms and register detail cards.

type.description: Input and validation data type for this register field.

required.description: Whether a non-empty value is mandatory when creating or updating records.

description.description: Optional helper description rendered underneath the field input.

options.description: Allowed option values when field type is select.

defaultValue.description: Optional default scalar value pre-populated on creation.

key.description: Canonical state machine status key stored in register_records.status.

label.description: British-English status label shown in the registers workspace.

isTerminal.description: When true, records in this state cease due and review reminders.

tone.description: Visual badge tone for this register status.

key.description: Unique transition action key within the register definition.

label.description: Button and audit label for this workflow transition.

fromStatuses.description: Allowed source status keys from which this transition may execute.

toStatus.description: Target status key applied atomically upon transition success.

requiredPermission.description: Minimum RBAC permission required to execute this transition.

allowedRoles.description: Optional allow-list of role keys permitted to execute this transition.

requiresComment.description: When true, a non-empty rationale or note is mandatory for this transition.

forbidSelfAction.description: When true, the record creator or owner is blocked from executing this transition.

requireAssignedApproverMatch.description: When true and assignedApproverId is set, only that assigned approver may execute the transition.

mustDifferFromPreviousApprover.description: When true, the actor executing this transition must differ from previous approval transition actors on the record.

distinctFromTransitionKeys.description: Transition keys whose prior actor(s) on this record must differ from the current actor.

setsDecidedAt.description: When true, sets decided_by_id and decided_at upon executing this transition.

requireTwoPersonApproval.description: Whether this register requires two-person approval workflow (must be null/false for direct undertakings).

forbidSelfApproval.description: Self-approval is unconditionally forbidden whenever approval rules are enabled.

allowedApproverRoles.description: Optional allow-list of role keys permitted to approve records in this register.

requireAssignedApproverMatch.description: When true, non-null assignedApproverId restricts approval transitions to that named approver.

allowAdminBypass.description: When false, the admin role cannot bypass allowedRoles / allowedApproverRoles restrictions.

enabled.description: Enables hourly scheduled due and periodic review reminders for this register.

dueDaysBefore.description: Day offsets relative to dueAt triggering reminders (negative = overdue follow-up).

reviewDaysBefore.description: Day offsets relative to reviewAt triggering periodic review reminders.

recipientMode.description: Determines which authorised users receive in-app register reminders (always filtered by matter restrictions).

key.description: Stable snake_case register type identifier stored on register_records.register_type_key.

label.description: Singular register record name in British English.

pluralLabel.description: Plural register display title shown in tabs and headings.

description.description: Short regulatory or operational summary of this register.

isCore.description: True for built-in core registers; false for tenant-defined custom registers.

enabled.description: Whether records in this register can be created and managed in the UI.

referencePrefix.description: Short uppercase reference prefix allocated when creating new entries (e.g. UND, CMP, REG).

initialStatus.description: Initial workflow status key assigned when creating a new record.

viewPermission.description: Optional explicit RBAC permission required to read entries in this register.

createPermission.description: RBAC permission required to create entries in this register.

editPermission.description: RBAC permission required to update fields on open entries in this register.

subjectScope.description: Restricts whether records attach to a matter, a client (person/organisation), or either.

requireMatterLink.description: When true, every record in this register must be linked to an existing matter.

approvalRules.description: Optional two-person approval rules (always null for undertakings).

reminderSchedule.description: Reminder lead-time and recipient rules for dueAt and reviewAt dates.

states.description: Ordered list of workflow states available in this register.

transitions.description: Permitted workflow state transitions and RBAC guards.

fields.description: Structured custom fields captured for records of this register type.

showInNavigation.description: Controls whether this register appears in top-level filter pills and workspace navigation.

enabled.description: Enables or disables a core or custom register type for the tenant.

label.description: Optional override singular label for the register type.

pluralLabel.description: Optional override plural title for the register type.

description.description: Optional override description for the register type.

showInNavigation.description: Optional visibility override for workspace tabs.

enabled.description: Enables or disables reminders for this register type.

additionalFields.description: Tenant-specific extra structured fields appended to a core register type.
